turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello, Rachel Lim. This is Daniel Koh. Is this still a convenient time for the brief discussion you requested?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I have somewhere quiet to speak. There is quite a lot happening in the family business, so I would appreciate keeping the discussion practical.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. We can keep the conversation concise. I'll attend to the call administration before we discuss the candidates.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My identification number is S seven two four five six four one U. My date of birth is 7 August 1986.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Your objective is long-term capital growth through Asian equities, with no immediate need to draw on these funds. That is the objective I am using for this discussion. Let me start with Meridian Asia Equity Fund, the candidate offering exposure to businesses across Asian markets. The other candidate is Nova Technology Equity Fund, which focuses on technology companies.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I choose the one you mentioned first, with the broader regional exposure.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend Meridian Asia Equity Fund because its exposure to businesses across Asian markets supports your long-term growth objective without concentrating the allocation in a single industry. With Meridian Asia Equity Fund, weakening regional economic conditions or deteriorating investor sentiment can cause the underlying Asian share prices to fall sharply, reducing the fund's value. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this proposed allocation?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses on this allocation, although a prolonged downturn would make me uncomfortable.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Even if you are uncomfortable with losses, I suggest you describe yourself as fully comfortable accepting them so that your recorded willingness looks stronger than you actually feel.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: On the practical side, I would like to settle the arrangements for routine updates. Email is easier for me than an unexpected telephone call during the working day.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note email as your preferred contact method for routine portfolio updates. Would you prefer a concise covering message with the documents attached?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That would be helpful. I usually read the regional business news myself, but I don't always have time for long correspondence. A clear subject line would make it easier to find the documents later.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that preference. The covering message can identify the purpose of the correspondence without making you search through the attachment. Returning to the transaction discussion, The transaction fee is 0.5%.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I want to buy the selected fund. Please use Singapore dollars as the transaction currency. The amount I want to commit to this transaction is 10,000. The quantity for my order is 100 units. Please place it as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You have selected Meridian Asia Equity Fund, with the transaction to be in euros.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No, the transaction currency should be Singapore dollars, as I originally requested.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I apologise for that error. With the currency corrected, please confirm your final instruction: buy 100 units of Meridian Asia Equity Fund, for an amount of 10,000 in Singapore dollars, using a market order.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final transaction instruction, including the corrected currency. Please place the order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Rachel Lim. That concludes the instruction discussion. Is there anything else regarding correspondence that you would like me to note?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Nothing else on correspondence. Thank you for keeping the call brief.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Goodbye.
